name: Can I change the color of my cabin interior if it is already stained a dark shade?

mainEntity.name: Can I change the color of my cabin interior if it is already stained a dark shade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, existing dark stain can be updated, but the method depends on your desired finish. Applying a darker stain or a rich gel stain over an existing coat is straightforward once the surface is cleaned and deglossed. However, transitioning from a dark stain to a lighter natural tone requires stripping or sanding the timber back down to bare wood. This is a labor-intensive process, especially on textured hand-hewn logs. An on-site evaluation helps determine whether stripping, sanding, or blending with a complementary tone makes the most sense.
acceptedAnswer.description: Going darker or adjusting the undertone is relatively straightforward, but lightening dark logs requires sanding or stripping back to raw wood, which requires substantial prep work.
